about: RFC 0020: the omni-ui keys Unfold's session plugin (@automagik/unfold-session-dsh) adds to the Bot team's namespace through its addStrings, recorded from its src/client/strings.js (ANSWER_WITH_ZH) at the hand-over commit below, when the Unfold plugins left this repository for Unfold's own.
